description: This PHP source file defines the TimeReportDataAPI class, which extends a base ReportDataAPI to serve as an API endpoint for retrieving time report data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes OpenAPI annotations for API documentation and contains a method to obtain a report object based on request parameters, validating the report name against predefined mappings.

classes.name: TimeReportDataAPI
classes.description: API class for fetching time report data, extending the base ReportDataAPI, with methods for report retrieval and validation.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and validates a report object based on the report name obtained from the request. Throws BadRequestException if the report name is invalid.
